title: Position
description: Represents a position in Workday. A position defines a role within a supervisory organization and can be filled by a worker.

id.description: The Workday ID of the position.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the position.

jobProfile.description: The job profile associated with this position.

jobProfileName.description: The name of the job profile.

businessTitle.description: The business title for this position.

supervisoryOrganization.description: The supervisory organization this position belongs to.

worker.description: The worker currently filling this position, if any.

positionTimeType.description: The time type for the position (e.g., Full Time, Part Time).

workerType.description: The worker type for this position (e.g., Employee, Contingent Worker).

workerSubType.description: The worker sub-type for the position.

location.description: The primary work location for the position.

compensationGrade.description: The compensation grade associated with this position.

payRateType.description: The pay rate type (e.g., Salary, Hourly).

isFilled.description: Whether the position is currently filled by a worker.

isAvailableForRecruit.description: Whether the position is available for recruiting.

isClosed.description: Whether the position has been closed.

availableDate.description: The date the position becomes available.

href.description: A link to the full position resource.

ResourceReference.description: A reference to a Workday resource.

id.description: The Workday ID of the referenced resource.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the referenced resource.

href.description: A link to the referenced resource.
